item.title: Larian boss is sick of players "shi***ng" on new games, and it feels like he's talking about Highguard
item.description: In the wake of all the Highguard discourse, Larian boss and BG3 icon Swen Vincke urges players to be respectful in their criticism.

item.title: The new Monster Hunter Wilds update is way better than I was expecting, and I can see the light at the end of the tunnel
item.description: The new Monster Hunter Wilds update aims to tackle its PC performance problems, and while it’s not perfect I’ve seen a notable upgrade.

item.title: Roblox is killing off classic heads for good, and it's not going down well
item.description: Roblox has updated its policy on dynamic heads, stating that any static designs still remaining by June will be removed from inventories.

item.title: AMD Ryzen 7 9850X3D review - true gaming CPU excellence
item.description: With a clock speed bump and... not much else, the AMD Ryzen 7 9850X3D still manages to impress as the fastest gaming CPU around.

item.title: With $250 of DLC to choose from, Paradox's new Crusader Kings 3 subscription is the answer to your choice paralysis
item.description: The new Crusader Kings 3 subscription pass gives you access to its entire DLC catalog, from Tours and Tournaments to All Under Heaven.

item.title: I never thought Stardew Valley and Diablo could coexist in one game, but then I saw Emberville
item.description: In Emberville, one minute you'll be watering your crops, the next you'll be slaying monsters and grinding to level up your favorite class.

item.title: Highguard roadmap - all updates coming in 2026 and beyond
item.description: Take a look at the Highguard roadmap to see all the upcoming Episodes and what they have to offer throughout the year.

item.title: The Terraria 1.4.5 secrets are starting to pour in, starting with a special boss so well-hidden you'll probably miss it
item.description: Among the early Terraria 1.4.5 secrets and spoilers are a range of new special seeds and a Skeletron fight to unlock the Chippy set.

item.title: New tactics game Warhounds wants to be the XCOM 3 we don't have, and it's targeting a smart approach to accuracy and RNG
item.description: Inspired by XCOM and Jagged Alliance, the turn-based tactics of Warhounds calculates every bullet separately to ensure “no safe shots.”

item.title: Grab a free Steam key for "ghostpunk" deckbuilder The Spirit Lift, a perfect answer to your Slay the Spire 2 woes
item.description: The Spirit Lift is a new Slay the Spire-style deckbuilder set in a haunted hotel, and we're giving away free Steam keys to ten lucky ghouls.
